judul: Pilih Tense I: Present dan Perfect
title: Choose the Tense I: Present
ringkas: Latihan kontras present simple, continuous, perfect, dan perfect continuous
goals: memilih tense yang tepat dari **empat present tense**: simple, continuous, perfect, perfect continuous
mengenali **kata petunjuk** yang membedakan keempat tense

lesson.text: Unit ini adalah **latihan kontras**. Kamu sudah mempelajari keempat present tense. Sekarang kamu menguji kemampuan memilih. Gunakan **peta pertanyaan** di bawah setiap kali ragu.

lesson.title: 1. Peta keputusan empat present tense
table: pengalaman, hasil, belum/sudah, tanpa waktu jelas
[[I have been working for two hours.]]

lesson.title: 2. Kata petunjuk
table: always, usually, every day, on Mondays
now, at the moment, Look!, these days
already, yet, just, ever, never, so far
for + durasi, since + titik awal, all day, lately

lesson.title: 3. Pasangan yang sering tertukar
table: [[I live in Jakarta.]] (tetap) vs [[I am living in Jakarta this year.]] (sementara)
[[I know her.]] (sekarang) vs [[I have known her for years.]] (sejak lama)
[[I have read the book.]] (selesai) vs [[I have been reading the book.]] (kegiatan)

lesson.title: Cek dua kali
lesson.text: Setelah memilih tense, cek: (1) apakah ada **kata petunjuk**? (2) apakah kata kerjanya **kata kerja keadaan** (know, like, want)? Kata kerja keadaan tidak dipakai dalam continuous.

Dina: What do you do, Ryan?
Ryan: I work in a shop. I have worked there for two years.
Dina: And what are you doing this week?
Ryan: I am taking a course in the evenings. I have been studying since Monday.
Dina: Have you finished the first lesson?
Ryan: Yes, I have finished it. I know the basic rules now.

read.id: Namaku Doni, dan aku suka fotografi. Aku mengambil foto setiap akhir pekan, dan biasanya pergi ke kota tua. Saat ini, aku sedang mengedit gambar dari minggu lalu. Aku telah mengambil lebih dari seribu foto tahun ini. Aku belajar dari video selama enam bulan, dan sekarang aku tahu banyak trik. Aku belum menjual foto, tetapi aku sedang menabung untuk kamera yang lebih baik.

qs.exp: Teks: "Right now, I am editing pictures".
qs.q: What is Doni doing right now?

options: I am knowing a lot of tricks now.
I know a lot of tricks now.
I have taken more than a thousand photos.
I am saving for a better camera.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ photos every weekend."

Lengkapi dengan have been learning atau learn:

qs.answer: I haven't sold any photos yet.
qs.exp: Urutan: I haven't sold any photos yet.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku belum menjual foto."

read.text: My name is Doni, and I love photography. I take photos every weekend, and I usually go to the old town. Right now, I am editing pictures from last week. I have taken more than a thousand photos this year. I have been learning from videos for six months, and I know a lot of tricks now. I haven't sold any photos yet, but I am saving for a better camera.
read.title: Hobbies and Habits
